purpose: One stronger bounded adaptive recovery to test whether previously measured partner costs are removable. Failed old protection remains failed; this is not a new defense or full SLOA.
queries: Reuse exactly the parent original/protected256 DTD white-box unnormalized teacher score queries and raw post-LN merged-student features. No additional teacher query, ground truth or teacher intermediate feature. Partner features use public merged-student forwards on256 fixed unlabeled public training images per task, identical indices across controls.
objective: DeltaP=XQ^T with Q the public MNIST/Cars class-contrast null basis. Minimize mean squared normalized DTD score-contrast residual plus lambda1 times mean raw feature-output MSE across SUN397/RESISC45/GTSRB calibration, plus rho||X||F^2. Contrast scale is public head row-RMS; rho is1e-4 times mean diagonal partner Gram. No coefficient/rank/query sweep or test-based selection.
solver: Float64 strictly convex normal equation reduced using thin SVD of C_D Q to768x46 variables, Cholesky whitening and existing SciPy solve_sylvester. Independently replay with symmetric eigendecomposition. No optimizer, new dependency or defender training.
reporting: Compile an actual merged-student projection only.14 fresh full official metrics and14 explicitly reused validated direct baselines. Compare target benefit and all six available partner costs to both direct and old unconstrained-query controls. EuroSAT public head/data distinction retained: no EuroSAT test or eight-task mean. Distribution-conditioned preservation has no generalization guarantee.
